text: Bull case: ES holds 7680 and makes its way up to the 7797 backtest. En route: 7720, 7745, 7758. To add on strength, 7720 reclaims are one spot, but it is a complex entry — use the non-acceptance protocol and make sure there is momentum.

source_quote: at 950AM today ES set a big low at 7676 from which we rallied to the high of day. A Failed Breakdown of this low AND 7680 to get long. Below there we likely just resume the drift lower where few supports hold.
text: Safer long than bidding 7680 direct: Friday 950AM set a big low at 7676 from which ES rallied to high of day — take a Failed Breakdown of this low AND 7680 to get long. Below there ES likely just resumes the drift lower where few supports hold.

trigger.condition_text: Failed Breakdown of the 7676 low AND 7680 recovers

source_quote: There are not many supports that have any real firmness until 7645-50. This is the backtest of a resistance shelf we broke out on August 4th. If its a slow grind into this, one can attempt a bid here. Personally I won't take this.
text: No real firmness below until 7645-50 — the backtest of the resistance shelf broken out August 4th. If it is a slow grind into it, one can attempt a bid there (he personally will not take it).

source_quote: The next level down of interest is 7627. While one could bid this, there is a safer option. Wait for it to hold, then recover 7637.
text: At 7627, the safer option than bidding direct is to wait for it to hold, then recover 7637 (a big August 3rd/4th level; 7632 was the massive August 4th low that launched the run to ATHs). Wait for 7632 AND 7637 to recover to take the long.

source_quote: If you want to try though, below 7650 is the spot. These types of level loss shorts below a support are called breakdown trades. ... Likely 7644 trigger down.
text: Bear case: bears control but there is not much to short below here that wouldn't amount to chasing. If trying, below 7650 is the spot — a breakdown trade (advanced, low win rate, high R/R; ~80% of breakdowns trap). Ideally price puts in a final bounce or a Failed Breakdown there, then short beneath the lows of that bounce. Likely 7644 trigger down.

source_quote: This means there are some back-testable shorts on bounces. Obviously 7794-97 is one region if we get up there. 7745 is another.
text: With the 7797 shelf broken and bears in control, there are back-testable shorts on bounces: 7794-97 is one region if price gets up there; 7745 is another.

source_quote: My general lean is we can rally to 7720, 7745, 7758, then 7797.
text: In summary: after a week of selling from the lost 7797 shelf, Friday put in the first Failed Breakdown (of 7680) and attempt to rally. General lean: ES can rally to 7720, 7745, 7758, then 7797.
